ns2:course.label: Health Policy: United States
ns2:course.description: Comprehensive analysis of the policy process in health care in the United States; systematic and critical review of health policy development, implementation, and evaluation; impact of government at all levels and the role of providers, industry, labor, and consumer in health policy. Prerequisite: Restricted to admission to graduate program in community health or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Restricted to admission to graduate program in community health or consent of instructor.
